description: The deposit contains two EPA SWMM 5.2.4 model configurations for an urban drainage network and infiltration ponds, including network geometry, hydraulic parameters and rainfall inputs. The metadata is published or maintained by Zarlenga, Antonio; Fiori, Aldo (provider deposit/publication). It describes a generic modelling method or tool. Its domain, time horizon and numerical resolution depend on the configuration; worldwide validation is not established. The provider page supplies a documented method or software entry point; package availability and execution requirements were not independently tested. Licence: CC-BY-4.0. The inspected public record or source repository is free to read; this does not grant rights beyond its stated licence. Caveats: Independent reuse and ongoing maintenance were not established; admission depends on the open single-study rule. For infrastructure simulation, its documented contents can support network flow. These are catalogue-use assessments, not additional validation claims. The provider describes Storm Water Management Model (SWMM). Related catalogue records are model-epa-swmm.
